title: Low-Glycemic Chicken Burrito Bowl Meal Prep
description: Using portion-controlled brown basmati rice paired with high-fiber black beans maintains a moderate GL (13.3). Greek yogurt and lean chicken breast drive a high 38g protein load, promoting GLP-1 secretion.
diabeticNotes: Using portion-controlled brown basmati rice paired with high-fiber black beans maintains a moderate GL (13.3). Greek yogurt and lean chicken breast drive a high 38g protein load, promoting GLP-1 secretion.

ingredients.name: skinless chicken breast, cubed and seasoned
cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
fresh pico de gallo (tomato, onion, cilantro, lime)

steps.title: Sear Seasoned Chicken
steps.description: Sear seasoned chicken breast cubes in a hot nonstick skillet lightly misted with olive oil for 6–7 minutes until fully cooked.

steps.title: Create Volume Base
steps.description: Lay shredded Romaine lettuce across one side of a wide bowl as the low-calorie volume base.

steps.title: Add Rice & Black Beans
steps.description: Add cooked brown rice and warm black beans side-by-side.

steps.title: Top with Grilled Chicken
steps.description: Place grilled chicken breast over the top.

steps.title: Garnish with Avocado & Crema
steps.description: Garnish with fresh pico de gallo, avocado slices, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.
